notes.title: VN Fest Sale
notes.notes:
Hey, for those who had CELL 0 wishlisted: here it comes. [b]50% discount[/b] on CELL 0 - Cyber Entertainment Leisure Lounge for the entirety of the Steam Visual Novel Fest. The discount is gonna be active until Mar 10, 2025. 

I hope that the fest will help CELL with finding its audience. The game was warmly received, but it was yet seen by a very limited amount of people.

I thank those who played the game ([b]avg. 2 hours playtime for a 3 hours game[/b] is really big), and I thank those who left their reviews after buying it (they're [b]all positive[/b], and it's also really big). 

I hope that the additional visibility that the fest provides will make the game meet its players.

...and, of course, I hope you'll enjoy the experience.

[i]glhf,
Iharo[/i]
